opportunities.title: British Academy Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers (post‑doctoral) in the humanities or social sciences who are based at a UK university or recognised research organisation. Applicants must have completed their viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027 and must not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year research award (80 % of salary costs under Full Economic Costing) to support an independent research project leading to a publishable output.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026‑27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK university or research organisation, working in the humanities or social sciences. Open to post‑doctoral, mid‑career and senior researchers.
opportunities.summary: Six‑ to twelve‑month awards (up to £10,000) to develop quantitative, data‑science, digital‑humanities, language or other research skills and to disseminate those skills more widely.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000 (plus up to £10,000 for public‑engagement costs)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a permanent or fixed‑term UK position, able to lead interdisciplinary collaborations across the Academies (Humanities/Social Sciences, Engineering, Natural Sciences).
opportunities.summary: Seed funding (up to 24 months, max £200,000) for interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research that bridges science, engineering and the humanities/social sciences.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher (early‑career to senior) in the humanities or social sciences who will work with a gallery, archive, library, museum or performing‑arts organisation.
opportunities.summary: Public‑engagement projects (up to £8,000) to develop innovative ways of bringing humanities/social‑science research to wider audiences.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships – DGAP 2026‑27

amount.raw: Awards for up to £150,000 for a 12‑month fellowship

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑ or mid‑career UK‑based researchers in the humanities or social sciences, placed in the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin for one year.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships (up to £150,000, 80 % FEC) to develop policy‑relevant research and networks across academia, government and the private sector.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences, with an established role, leading a project with international partners and interdisciplinary collaboration across SHAPE and/or STEM disciplines.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year, up‑to‑£300k awards to investigate ‘Mobility’ themes (people, materials, ideas) through genuinely interdisciplinary international research.

opportunities.title: Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027 – Humboldt Foundation
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers based at UK or German institutions, working in the humanities or social sciences, who wish to attend a three‑day symposium on ‘Humans and Nature’.
opportunities.summary: Attendance at a research‑collaboration symposium (travel, accommodation, visa costs covered) with seed‑funding for follow‑up collaborations.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs Funding

amount.raw: Up to £4,000 (higher amounts possible in exceptional cases)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants who will apply for a British Academy award within the next six months, and who have a UK‑based affiliation.
opportunities.summary: One‑off support to cover specific additional costs (e.g., disability equipment, caring costs, assistance with application preparation) for award‑holders or applicants.
